tcpdump.org source tarballs trojanized

Target: tcpdump/libpcap
Repository: https://github.com/the-tcpdump-group/tcpdump
Date: 2002-11-11 to 2002-11-13 (2 days)
Attribution: Unknown attacker
Component: Application
Language: C
Cause: Compromised Infrastructure
Motive: Unauthorized Access
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Backdoor, Remote code execution
User Impact: 0
Domain: tcpdump.org (project download host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The tcpdump.org distribution site was compromised in November 2002, and source archives for tcpdump and libpcap were replaced with trojanized versions. The inserted code ran during compilation, connected to a remote IRC server on port 6667, and accepted commands, turning packet-analysis tooling into a remote-access foothold for systems that built from the poisoned official archives.

Compromised Versions

  • tcpdump 3.6.2
  • tcpdump 3.7.1
  • libpcap 0.7.1
